name: Canva template creator
summary: Design templates for Canva's library and earn monthly royalties based on how often Canva users use them. You get in through a portfolio application, and the program is listed as being in beta.
whatYouDo: Once accepted, you design customizable templates (social posts, presentations, flyers and so on) to Canva's baseline requirements and submit them for review. Approved templates go into Canva's library, and you're paid from a monthly royalty pool according to how much your templates are used.
appeal: Free to apply, and you design in Canva itself
Paid on usage of both Free and Pro templates, from a royalty pool that grows with Canva's subscription revenue
Payouts via PayPal, Payoneer or Skrill
Work entirely on your own schedule
watchOuts: You must apply with a portfolio and be accepted. Canva says the template creator program is in beta
Applications to become an element creator are paused (Canva creators page)
Canva says it may take up to a couple of months to be signed on (education creator page)
There is no official earnings range. Third-party blog claims of $50–$500+ a month are unverified
Income depends on usage within a very large library, so it's unpredictable
Sources found don't say which countries can join as a creator

training.notes: Review guidelines are provided after acceptance. An older blog says applicants once had to pass a design challenge (may be outdated).

compensation.notes: Official: monthly royalty pool shared by template usage (downloads, prints, presentations) of Free and Pro templates; paid on or before the 15th once a payout threshold is reached (one blog says $10 USD, unverified). No official earnings figures. Canva separately announced (2023) a $200M fund for creators who opt in to AI training use.

reliability.notes: Royalties depend on how often users pick your templates; no worker reports on typical earnings were found.

applicationSteps: Build a portfolio of templates designed to be customized
Apply to the Canva Creators template program with your portfolio
If accepted, follow the baseline requirements and review guidelines and submit templates
Set up PayPal, Payoneer or Skrill to receive monthly royalties
fitsIf: You design clean, reusable layouts and want a low-pressure creative side income built up over time.
notFitIf: You need income soon or a clear idea of what you'll earn.
